service.description: Return the user group the caller may actually grant. Non-admins cannot change a group at all; admins cannot grant GROWERP_M_SYSTEM. An unknown group is rejected.

parameter.name: requestedUserGroupId
parameter.description: Group asked for by the client, may be null

parameter.name: trustGroup
parameter.description: The caller already decided the group server-side (registration, tenant creation). Never derive this from the absence of a session: an anonymous REST request can run on a pooled thread that still carries the previous request's user.

parameter.name: currentUserGroupId
parameter.description: Group the user has now; returned unchanged when the caller may not change it

return.message: Not authorized to assign user group ${requestedUserGroupId}
Only a system user can migrate user groups

service.description: Return AUTHZT_ALWAYS or AUTHZT_DENY for one REST path, from the caller's group and the menu of the caller's organization.

return.message: Only a system user can migrate REST authorization
